lessons.title: Public Battery Cycling Dataset Taxonomy & Download Matrix
lessons.summary: Navigate NASA, Oxford, MIT-Stanford, and Sandia open-access battery cycling databases with standardized column schemas.
checkpoints: Filter datasets by C-rate and temperature range

lessons.title: Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) Repository Analysis
lessons.summary: Explore Nyquist and Bode impedance spectra across SOC levels and temperatures for equivalent circuit modeling.
checkpoints: Identify high-frequency inductive loop and charge-transfer semicircle

lessons.title: Microstructure & Synchrotron X-ray Computed Tomography (CT)
lessons.summary: Access 3D electrode reconstruction datasets: particle tortuosity, active material volume fraction, and binder distribution.
checkpoints: Understand correlation with fast-charging plating risk

lessons.title: Automated Benchmark Data Validation & Upstream Sync Pipeline
lessons.summary: Deploy GitHub Actions workflow to check URL liveness, parse upstream additions, and render interactive searchable tables.
checkpoints: Automatic pull request creation for schema drift
